judgment: It is good to hold firm.
It is good to set out.
lines: He digs deep for what lasts.
He does not last in his virtue,
and so he may bear shame for it.
but there is no game in it.
She lasts in her virtue and holds firm:

notes.name_en: 恆 is constancy through time; 'Lasting', not Wilhelm's 'Duration'.
notes.L1: 浚恆 digging deep at once for permanence — depth seized too soon.
notes.L4: 田無禽: B supplies the hunter implied by the empty field; no game is the whole statement.
notes.L5: 恆其德貞: the lasting one is the wife of the verdict's first half; B gives her the sentence, husband as contrast.
